data.action: 仰靠在长椅上享受午后阳光，嘴角带着惬意微笑
data.description: 【能天使 · 长椅小憩】午后阳光洒满公园的木质长椅上，能天使双臂枕在脑后仰靠在椅背上，惬意地享受着暖阳与微风，嘴角噙着无忧无虑的灿烂微笑——「偶尔像这样什么也不思考、只晒晒太阳发呆，感觉灵魂都被充满电了呢。老板，今天就准我放半天假吧！」
data.promptProse: With both arms behind her head, Exusiai leans back on a sun-warmed park bench, smiling in her black shirt, white jacket, shorts and dark thighhighs. The medium view keeps the wooden seat beneath her and a park path receding beyond its end. Soft afternoon light spreads across her cheek and jacket sleeve, and the bench slats cast subdued stripes on the ground.
data.title: 能天使 · 长椅小憩
